item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:50 HKT 07/Jul/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Danas will move across the coastal areas of western Taiwan today, and then edge closer to the vicinity of Zhejiang. Meanwhile, a southwesterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong. The weather will be very hot with showers over the region. A trough of low pressure is expected to bring heavy showers and thunderstorms to Guangdong and the northern part of the South China Sea in the middle and latter parts of this week. With the trough of low pressure weakening, showers will ease off gradually over the weekend. The weather will be brighter early next week.
